latin: Nulla potentia actiua quae sit mere neutra et indifferens ad agere uel non agere potest ex se determinari ad alterum agendum.
translation: A power that is purely neutral and indifferent between acting and not acting cannot, on its own, settle itself toward one alternative rather than the other.
